checkStatePredicate(bytes32,address,addr.details: Returns false if the predicate is unknown, no observation exists,      the presented evidence root is stale (not the latest), or the      observation is too old. This closes the TOCTOU gap: the executor      must prove state is still current at the moment of execution.

params.evidenceRoot: Merkle/USC root that PROVED this value on the source chain
params.sourceBlock: Block number on the source chain
params.sourceChain: Source chain identifier (e.g., keccak256 of chain id)
params.sourceContract: Contract on the source chain that emitted the state
params.subject: The agent/subject this observation concerns

checkStatePredicate(bytes32,address,addr.notice: Evaluate a predicate against the CURRENT verified state.

createPredicate(uint256,uint8,uint256).notice: Register a state predicate. The returned hash is what a state-bound         capability commits to at creation time.

getLatestObservation(bytes32,address,add.notice: Get the latest observation for a subject/metric.

recordStateObservation(bytes32,address,a.notice: Record a fresh, USC-verified state observation.

setVerifier(address,bool).notice: Register an authorized verifier (a USC worker in production)
